snapshot.text: Fragmented system of social security institutes (IMSS, ISSSTE) and IMSS-Bienestar for people without social security. The government is building a Servicio Universal de Salud so anyone can use any public institution, with PAHO/WHO support.

priorities.title: Universal Health Service
priorities.text: The Servicio Universal de Salud will have 12,750 consulting rooms to expand primary care in 2027.

priorities.title: Universal electronic health record
priorities.text: President Sheinbaum announced a universal electronic clinical record for the whole health system.

priorities.title: New hospitals and vaccination
priorities.text: The government reports 33 new hospitals and more than 149 million vaccine doses in two years.
